name: VorpX
summary: Commercial VR injector with curated profiles for hundreds of games. Offers two core rendering modes: Geometry 3D (Dual-View Rendering via driver hooks) and Z-Normal (Single-View Depth Reprojection via depth buffer). Also supports Cinema mode for flat-screen VR. A half-width SBS stereo3D output exists for non-HMD stereo3D displays — flagged as experimental inside vorpX itself.
compatibility_notes: Paid (~€40 one-time). Performance overhead vs native. Next-gen game updates can break profiles. Z-Normal mode has depth artifacts typical of depth reprojection. Half-SBS output for flat 3D displays is officially experimental.

sbs.notes: Available for flat stereo3D displays via vorpX's experimental half-SBS mode (not the primary use case).

sbs_half.notes: vorpX's experimental half-SBS output mode for stereo3D monitors / SR displays.
